segs: Daniel, this place is huge and so cheap.
Don't get me wrong, I love it too. But why so cheap?
The agent said it's really lively at night.
What do you mean by lively?
Like lots of energy and people around.
Wait, the floor is shaking. Is this bowling?
Oh no, there's a bowling alley right below us.
A twenty-four-hour one? This is crazy.
I swear the ad said nothing about this.
We would never sleep with all that noise.
Yeah, pins crashing all night long.
Free bowling shoes almost make up for it.
But residents get free bowling shoes. I'm signing.
